premises.text: Multichannel selling lifts sales but is tedious and hard to manage in real time because merchants must switch platforms and replicate listings, orders, and inventory tracking
premises.evidence_span: Multichannel selling can be tedious, time-consuming, and extremely difficult to manage in real time

premises.text: A centralized dashboard lets merchants sell, track, and manage inventory across multiple sales channels simultaneously
premises.evidence_span: The Syncommerce centralized dashboard allows online merchants to sell, track, and manage inventory across multiple sales channels simultaneously

premises.text: Real-time multi-directional syncing of product data with customizable sync scope prevents overselling and manual inventory updates
premises.evidence_span: real-time multi-directional syncing of product data, and the ability to customize which product's data to sync

premises.text: Affordable monthly subscription tiers for small businesses based on products listed and channels connected
premises.evidence_span: Syncommerce provides affordable and optimized solutions for small businesses

premises.text: Integrations with major marketplaces (Shopify, eBay, Etsy, and Amazon) enable cross-platform selling for the target merchant segment
premises.evidence_span: We currently have integrations with Shopify, eBay, and Etsy

value.text: Online merchants sell more across channels while working less through centralized multichannel retailing

causal_links.evidence_span: Multichannel selling can be tedious, time-consuming, and extremely difficult to manage in real time
